This mod is compatible with any modpack and keeps the vanilla feel of the game!

template_audit_limit: Raw archived templates, not effective overlays, generated-world locations or runtime compatibility. No Broadwater data included.
practical_tests: ZIP/NBT parsing and checksums only; no game execution
timestamp_limit: Source receipts preserve original precision. Day-only and filesystem-mtime-only records are not asserted as exact network capture times.

method_findings: RandomizableContainer.trySaveLootTable: false on null key; table and nonzero seed otherwise
ChestBlockEntity and BarrelBlockEntity: trySaveLootTable false selects item serialization
ContainerEntity: analogous table/seed versus items save/load, unpack clears key
official_bytecode_analysis.scope: Static primary-bytecode inspection. No game execution; no generalized runtime or all-structure-method proof.

source_receipt_check_history.batch: cleanup and command source captures added after review

capture_check_precision: All checks occurred on2026-11-23 across the recorded successive batches; this final record time is not a new simultaneous recheck of every source. Original retrieval precision remains per record.

independent_review_v1.scope: Focused research review, not runtime or source-delivery approval

corrections.vanilla_method_proof: Closed by official artifact/class identity and bytecode trace recorded here
corrections.engine_boundary: Explicit upstream source hook or narrow fork, no demonstrated public historical registration API; standalone utility owns its own state/menu/transactions; estimate contingent on spike
corrections.private_copy_cleanup: Marker loss and forget operations can delete all copies; tested all-player export/escrow is a hard gate
corrections.source_identity: Immutable historical IDs/fail-closed behavior labeled proposed acceptance, not current engine behavior
corrections.historical_reward: New approved entitlements, not original roll/looter recovery
